dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: Why are you staring at me like that?

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Wait... the koi just talked...?

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: Stay in this water long enough, and you'll learn to speak a little too.

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: First, take a good look at the flow of the water.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: The flow of the water...?

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: Did you see the water grass swaying?

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Yes. The surface was calm, but the grass was swaying gently beneath.

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: Even when the surface is still, the water never stops flowing.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Now that you mention it, all the grass was swaying in the same direction.

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: That direction is the way the water flows.

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: Watch the swaying of the grass, and you'll understand how the water moves.

updateNotebook.memo: Even when the surface is calm, the water never stops flowing.
updateNotebook.quote: Watch the swaying of the grass, and you'll understand how the water moves.
updateNotebook.speaker: koi

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: Did you see the surface of the Okawa River?

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Yes. The light reflecting off it was beautiful.

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: The shimmer on the surface is proof that the water is moving.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Moving...?

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: At a speed you can't see, the water is always flowing.

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: Gaze at the surface long enough, and you'll begin to see its movement.

updateNotebook.memo: The shimmer on the surface is proof that the water is moving.
updateNotebook.quote: Gaze at the surface long enough, and you'll begin to see its movement.
updateNotebook.speaker: koi

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: The water is especially clear today.

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: After seeing the inside of the inn, it seems you understand how water sustains daily life.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Yes. The same water was used for cooking and all other daily needs.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: I've never seen this kind of water circulation system anywhere else.

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: That's right. This is the unique relationship between people and nature that you'll only find in Harie.

dialogs.speaker: koi
dialogs.text: Pulling this off isn't easy, you know.
